# Generated by the ZIN content builder (the journey-slice mechanic modules). Do not edit; change the module data in tools/content/data/mech_journey_*.json.
# Effects of the Yeldenne and Glo mechanic. Arguments are temporary variables zin_arg_<name> set just before the call (E1).
zin_yeldenne_add_wards = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_yeldenne_wards = zin_arg_value }
	set_temp_variable = { glo_wards_max = constant:zin_glo.wards_max }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_yeldenne_wards min = 0 max = glo_wards_max }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0 }
}
zin_glo_add_power = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_glo_power = zin_arg_value }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_power > global.zin_glo_power_cap } } set_variable = { global.zin_glo_power = global.zin_glo_power_cap } }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_glo_power min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0 }
}
zin_glo_on_sword_broken = {
	# Zol crushed the blue sword (zin_mistake.21 sets zin_horos_sword_broken, N1): Glo keeps less of Glernaen's power from here on. Runs once.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_glo_sword_handled } }
		set_global_flag = zin_glo_sword_handled
		set_variable = { global.zin_glo_power_cap = constant:zin_glo.power_max_broken }
		set_variable = { global.zin_glo_power = constant:zin_glo.power_broken }
	}
}
zin_glo_clear_seal_keepers = {
	# Glo has left the hall (or dimmed): the regional tree's seal-keepers spirit has nothing left to keep.
	YEL = {
		if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_regional_yeldenne_seal_keepers } remove_ideas = zin_regional_yeldenne_seal_keepers }
	}
}
zin_glo_follow_bearer = {
	# Glernaen's Light rests on the host that employs the bearer, and moves with him.
	every_country = { limit = { has_idea = zin_glo_glernaens_light } remove_ideas = zin_glo_glernaens_light }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 1 } has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host }
		var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				add_ideas = zin_glo_glernaens_light
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 4 } }
		random_country = {
			limit = { any_unit_leader = { has_character_flag = zin_glo_bearer } }
			add_ideas = zin_glo_glernaens_light
		}
	}
}
zin_yeldenne_set_hall_modifier = {
	1063 = {
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_yeldenne_hall_wards } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_yeldenne_hall_wards } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_yeldenne_sealed_hall } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_yeldenne_sealed_hall } }
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_yeldenne_empty_hall } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_yeldenne_empty_hall } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_horos_dead }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 2 } }
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_yeldenne_sealed_hall }
			}
			else = {
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_yeldenne_empty_hall }
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_yeldenne_hall_wards }
		}
	}
}
zin_glo_pick_second_bearer = {
	set_temp_variable = { glo_picked = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { glo_picked = 0 } any_unit_leader = { is_field_marshal = yes skill > 8 } }
		set_temp_variable = { glo_picked = 1 }
		random_unit_leader = {
			limit = { is_field_marshal = yes skill > 8 }
			set_character_flag = zin_glo_bearer
			add_unit_leader_trait = zin_glo_second_bearer
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { glo_picked = 0 } any_unit_leader = { is_field_marshal = yes skill > 7 } }

			limit = { is_field_marshal = yes skill > 7 }
			set_character_flag = zin_glo_bearer
			add_unit_leader_trait = zin_glo_second_bearer

		set_temp_variable = { glo_picked = 1 }
		random_unit_leader = {
			limit = { is_field_marshal = yes skill > 3 }
			set_character_flag = zin_glo_bearer
			add_unit_leader_trait = zin_glo_second_bearer
		}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { glo_picked = 0 } any_unit_leader = { is_field_marshal = yes skill > 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { glo_picked = 1 }
		random_unit_leader = {
			limit = { is_field_marshal = yes skill > 2 }
			set_character_flag = zin_glo_bearer
			add_unit_leader_trait = zin_glo_second_bearer

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { glo_picked = 0 } any_unit_leader = { is_field_marshal = yes skill > 1 } }

		random_unit_leader = {

			set_character_flag = zin_glo_bearer

zin_glo_transfer = {
	# Glo moves only here. zin_arg_to: 1 Eindil, 2 a second bearer (ROOT is the claimant), 3 sealed in the hall. Nobody unworthy ever holds it (O3).
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_to = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 1 }
		set_global_flag = zin_glo_with_eindil
		set_variable = { global.zin_glo_power = constant:zin_glo.power_max }
		zin_glo_clear_seal_keepers = yes
		zin_glo_follow_bearer = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_to = 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 4 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_glo_power = constant:zin_glo.power_max }
		zin_glo_pick_second_bearer = yes
		zin_glo_clear_seal_keepers = yes
		zin_glo_follow_bearer = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 2 }
		set_global_flag = zin_glo_sealed
	}
	zin_yeldenne_set_hall_modifier = yes
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_to = 0 }
}
zin_glo_hall_wards_tick = {
	# Every pulse the wards harm an enemy army that holds or stands in Mp'E; the band follows the wards.
	1063 = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_yeldenne_wards < constant:zin_glo.wards_mid } }
			damage_units = {
				state = THIS
				limit = { has_war_with = ROOT }
				org_damage = 0.5
				str_damage = 0.05
				ratio = yes
				army = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_yeldenne_wards < constant:zin_glo.wards_high } }
			damage_units = {
				state = THIS
				limit = { has_war_with = ROOT }
				org_damage = 0.5
				str_damage = 0.1
				ratio = yes
				army = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			damage_units = {
				state = THIS
				limit = { has_war_with = ROOT }
				org_damage = 0.5
				str_damage = 0.15
				ratio = yes
				army = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_glo_hall_occupation_tick = {
	# After 28 days of enemy control the hall expels the intruders and its owner holds Mp'E again.
	1063 = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_controlled_by = ROOT } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zin_glo_occupied_since } }
				set_variable = { zin_glo_occupied_since = global.num_days }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { glo_held = global.num_days }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { glo_held = zin_glo_occupied_since }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { glo_held > constant:zin_glo.expel_days } }
				controller = {
					country_event = { id = zin_glo.62 }
				}
				set_state_controller_to = ROOT
				clear_variable = zin_glo_occupied_since
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = zin_glo_occupied_since } clear_variable = zin_glo_occupied_since }
		}
	}
}
zin_glo_regen_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { zin_glo_in_play = yes }
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_glo_regen_days = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_regen_days > 27 } }
			set_variable = { global.zin_glo_regen_days = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = constant:zin_glo.regen_power }
			zin_glo_add_power = yes
		}
	}
}
zin_glo_sword_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_horos_sword_broken NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_glo_sword_handled } }
		zin_glo_on_sword_broken = yes
	}
}
zin_glo_watch_check = {
	# The northern watch ends when the guarantee does.
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_idea = zin_glo_northern_watch }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_guaranteed_by = ROOT } }
			remove_ideas = zin_glo_northern_watch
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { any_country = { has_idea = zin_glo_northern_watch } } }
		clr_global_flag = zin_glo_watch_active
	}
}
zin_glo_defile_check = {
	# Defiling ends after a year of black rites (545 days when the seal is warded) and Glo dims for good.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_defile_end > 0 } check_variable = { global.num_days > global.zin_glo_defile_end } }
		clr_global_flag = zin_glo_defiling
		set_variable = { global.zin_glo_defile_end = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 3 }
		set_global_flag = zin_glo_dimmed
		zin_glo_clear_seal_keepers = yes
		zin_yeldenne_set_hall_modifier = yes
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = constant:zin_glo.dark_glo_dims }
		zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			news_event = { id = zin_glo.51 }
		}
	}
}
zin_glo_wave_scan = {
	# Caches, once a pulse, whether the dead of the Mistake stand near the bearer's army (Glo's Wave reads the flag).
	clr_global_flag = zin_glo_wave_ready
	random_state = {
		limit = { zin_glo_wave_target = yes }
		set_global_flag = zin_glo_wave_ready
	}
}
zin_glo_story_check = {
	# The Deliverer's party reaches the approach; a party that came to strike at once does so; the watch and the defilement run their courses.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_at_yeldenne NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_glo_approach_seen } zin_horos_alive = yes }
		set_global_flag = zin_glo_approach_seen
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes }
			country_event = { id = zin_glo.11 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_afrit_hall_at_once }
			zin_glo_afrit_strikes = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_glo_watch_active }
		zin_glo_watch_check = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_glo_defiling }
		zin_glo_defile_check = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { zin_glo_in_play = yes }
		zin_glo_wave_scan = yes
	}
}
zin_glo_wave = {
	# Scope: the struck state. zin_arg_first: 1 for the first wave (the sword in the earth), else 0. Only Zol's dead are unmade;
	# no Zol or warfare effect takes part, so nothing returns through Zol's return of the fallen.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_first = 1 } }
		damage_units = {
			state = THIS
			limit = { OR = { original_tag = ZOL is_subject_of = ZOL } }
			org_damage = 1
			str_damage = 1
			ratio = yes
			army = yes
		}
		every_neighbor_state = {
			limit = { controller = { OR = { original_tag = ZOL is_subject_of = ZOL } } }
			damage_units = {
				state = THIS
				limit = { OR = { original_tag = ZOL is_subject_of = ZOL } }
				org_damage = 1
				str_damage = 1
				ratio = yes
				army = yes
			}
			set_state_flag = { flag = zin_glo_cleansed days = 60 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		damage_units = {
			state = THIS
			limit = { OR = { original_tag = ZOL is_subject_of = ZOL } }
			org_damage = 1
			str_damage = 0.5
			ratio = yes
			army = yes
		}
	}
	set_state_flag = { flag = zin_glo_cleansed days = 60 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_first = 0 }
}
zin_glo_wave_battlefield = {
	# The first wave of the return, on the battlefield state the journey stored (any scope).
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_battlefield }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_first = 1 }
		var:global.zin_eindil_battlefield = {
			zin_glo_wave = yes
		}
	}
}
zin_glo_wave_decided = {
	# The decision: pay the bearer's power, strike a state next to the army that holds the dead.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -30 }
	zin_glo_add_power = yes
	random_state = {
		limit = { zin_glo_wave_target = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_first = 0 }
		zin_glo_wave = yes
	}
}
zin_yeldenne_install_warden = {
	# Horos is dust: the Warden of Mp'E rules for the hall. The wards spirits of the regional tree stay only while the crystal lies sealed.
	YEL = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			recruit_character = zin_yeldenne_warden
			add_country_leader_role = { character = zin_yeldenne_warden promote_leader = yes country_leader = { ideology = zin_light_wardens expire = "2000.1.1.1" traits = { zin_yeldenne_warden_trait } } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 2 } } }
				if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_regional_yeldenne_glernaens_wards } remove_ideas = zin_regional_yeldenne_glernaens_wards }
				if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_regional_yeldenne_glernaens_wards_2 } remove_ideas = zin_regional_yeldenne_glernaens_wards_2 }
			}
		}
	}
}
zin_glo_request_northern_watch = {
	# From Yeldenne's focus: the Lost Cause's leader is asked to send a company to the gate.
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_glo_lost_cause_leader = yes }
		set_variable = { global.zin_glo_watch_sender = THIS }
		country_event = { id = zin_glo.64 }
	}
}
zin_glo_horos_falls = {
	# Horos is dust. Wardens keep the hall; the guard stands down; the world hears of it.
	set_global_flag = zin_horos_dead
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_character = zin_horos }
		retire_character = zin_horos
	}
	zin_yeldenne_install_warden = yes
	YEL = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_yeldenne_guardian_of_glo } remove_ideas = zin_yeldenne_guardian_of_glo }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_yeldenne_the_empty_throne days = 365 }
		}
	}
	zin_yeldenne_set_hall_modifier = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		news_event = { id = zin_glo.30 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = constant:zin_glo.dark_horos_dies }
	zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
}
zin_glo_give_to_heir = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_to = 1 }
	zin_glo_transfer = yes
	zin_eindil_fire_bearer_leaves = yes
}
zin_glo_hall_holds = {
	# The attacker is repelled: the wards fall by a fifth, the hall is proved, and its owner keeps Horos.
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -20 }
	zin_yeldenne_add_wards = yes
	set_global_flag = zin_horos_endures
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -3 }
	zin_world_add_gathering_dark = yes
}
zin_glo_score = {
	# score = wards + 30 + 10 if forewarned + 10 if unyielding + random(-10..+10) - attacker (zin_arg_case 5: Volgan's hunt, else Afrit's artifacts); sets global.zin_glo_hall_score.
	set_temp_variable = { glo_score = global.zin_yeldenne_wards }
	add_to_temp_variable = { glo_score = constant:zin_glo.hall_base }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_yeldenne_forewarned }
		add_to_temp_variable = { glo_score = constant:zin_glo.hall_forewarned }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_yeldenne_hall_unyielding }
		add_to_temp_variable = { glo_score = constant:zin_glo.hall_unyielding }
	}
	set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = glo_roll min = -10 max = 11 integer = yes }
	add_to_temp_variable = { glo_score = glo_roll }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_case = 5 } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { glo_score = constant:zin_glo.volgan_hunt }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { glo_art = global.zin_afrit_artifacts }
		multiply_temp_variable = { glo_art = constant:zin_glo.afrit_per_artifact }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { glo_score = glo_art }
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_glo_hall_score = glo_score }
}
zin_glo_show_hall = {
	# The scene in the hall, to its owner and to the party that came (the Worshipdom in cases 1, 2 and 4). The outcome follows a day later.
	1063 = {
		owner = {
			country_event = { id = zin_glo.20 }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes NOT = { owns_state = 1063 } NOT = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_hall_case = 3 } } NOT = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_hall_case = 5 } } }
		country_event = { id = zin_glo.20 }
	}
}
zin_glo_resolve_hall = {
	# zin_arg_case: 1 A (Afrit first, then the heir), 2 B1 (two against one), 3 B2 (the willing gift), 4 C (Afrit alone), 5 D (Volgan's hunt).
	set_variable = { global.zin_glo_hall_case = zin_arg_case }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_case = 1 } }
		zin_glo_horos_falls = yes
		zin_afrit_wound = yes
		zin_glo_give_to_heir = yes
		1063 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id = zin_glo.21 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		zin_glo_show_hall = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_case = 2 } }
		zin_glo_horos_falls = yes
		zin_afrit_wound = yes
		zin_glo_give_to_heir = yes
		1063 = {
			owner = {
				country_event = { id = zin_glo.23 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes NOT = { owns_state = 1063 }  }
			country_event = { id = zin_glo.23 days = 1 }
		}
		zin_glo_show_hall = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_case = 3 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_glo_heir_in_hall
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_yeldenne_awaits_heir }
			1063 = {
				owner = {
					country_event = { id = zin_glo.3 days = 30 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			1063 = {
				owner = {
					country_event = { id = zin_glo.3 days = 60 }
				}
			}
		}
		zin_glo_show_hall = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_arg_case = 4 } }
		zin_glo_score = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_hall_score > 49 } }
			zin_glo_hall_holds = yes
			zin_afrit_wound = yes
			1063 = {
				owner = {
					country_event = { id = zin_glo.24 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes NOT = { owns_state = 1063 }  }
				country_event = { id = zin_glo.24 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			zin_glo_horos_falls = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_to = 3 }
			zin_glo_transfer = yes
			1063 = {
				owner = {
					country_event = { id = zin_glo.25 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			every_country = {
				limit = { zin_afrit_is_hub = yes NOT = { owns_state = 1063 }  }
				country_event = { id = zin_glo.25 days = 1 }
			}
		}
		zin_glo_show_hall = yes
	}
	else = {
		zin_glo_score = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_hall_score > 49 } }
			zin_glo_hall_holds = yes
			PUV = {
				add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_glo_wound_of_yeldenne days = 365 }
				country_event = { id = zin_glo.24 days = 1 }
			}
			1063 = {
				owner = {
					country_event = { id = zin_glo.24 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			zin_glo_horos_falls = yes
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_to = 3 }
			zin_glo_transfer = yes
			PUV = {
				country_event = { id = zin_glo.25 days = 1 }
			}
			1063 = {
				owner = {
					country_event = { id = zin_glo.25 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_case = 0 }
}
zin_glo_hall_historical = {
	# The journey calls this 14 days after the ambush, when Afrit reached the hall first (case A).
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_case = 1 }
	zin_glo_resolve_hall = yes
}
zin_glo_afrit_strikes = {
	# The Worshipdom's party enters the hall now: alone (case C), or against the heir already inside (case B1).
	if = {
		limit = { zin_horos_alive = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_glo_heir_in_hall }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_case = 2 }
			clr_global_flag = zin_glo_heir_in_hall
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_case = 4 }
		}
		zin_glo_resolve_hall = yes
	}
}
zin_glo_heir_arrives = {
	# The journey calls this when Eindil reaches the castle. Sealed Glo opens for him; Horos tests him; dimmed Glo is lost to him.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = zin_yeldenne_calls_heir }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
			zin_eindil_add_renown = yes
			1063 = {
				owner = {
					country_event = { id = zin_glo.80 }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			1063 = {
				owner = {
					country_event = { id = zin_glo.80 days = 30 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_glo_state = 3 } }
		set_global_flag = zin_glo_heir_found_dim
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { zin_horos_alive = yes NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_glo_heir_in_hall } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_case = 3 }
		zin_glo_resolve_hall = yes
	}
}
zin_glo_second_bearer_claimed = {
	# ROOT is the claimant: the stone judges and the claimant's best marshal carries it.
	save_global_event_target_as = zin_glo_claimant
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_to = 2 }
	zin_glo_transfer = yes
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		news_event = { id = zin_glo.70 }
	}
}
zin_glo_dispatch_hunters = {
	# The Worshipdom's hunters sail south; the journey's hunters event reaches the island host in 90 days.
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = global.zin_eindil_wreck_host }
		var:global.zin_eindil_wreck_host = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				country_event = { id = zin_eindil.46 days = 90 }
			}
		}
	}
}
